story: After an early battle, a six-rider breakaway quickly built a sizeable lead. NSN initially led the chase before UAE took control in the hills. Wellens accelerated on Redmire and reached the remaining escapees, with only Bol able to follow. The pair stayed clear, Bol winning the sprint and Wellens taking the overall lead.
